title: Anatomy atlas, MRI (AI)
description: Anatomy outlines for the Learn-mode anatomy layer (layer 'atlas') on MRI series: the arteries of the Circle of Willis on the time-of-flight MR angiograms (A1/A2, P1/P2 and M1/M2 where the junction is seen) and the brain's lobes, central-sulcus gyri, ventricles, deep grey nuclei, hippocampus, amygdala, brainstem and cerebellum on the brain MRIs of brain-mra, neuro-msk, expansion, ct-tumors, stroke-mri, stroke-mri-2, stroke-mri-3, after automatic QC and a visual check of every case. Not reviewed by a radiologist; never used for grading. No images: targets reference those packs' series and SOP UIDs.

sources.name: Horalix (horalix.com)
sources.license: AI-generated drafts for this app; the segmentation tools and their licences are listed in docs/data/anatomy-atlas-mr-report.md
sources.citation: Thanks to Horalix.com, every structure in the anatomy layer is marked. The outlines are AI, not reviewed by a radiologist.
sources.accessNote: Unreviewed AI drafts; never used for grading.

Benchmarking the CoW with the TopCoW challenge: topology-aware anatomical segmentation of the Circle of Willis for CTA and MRA. arXiv:2312.17670. Data: Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.15692630.
